name: text-coercion
body: A `text` field may declare `coerce: true`. With `coerce: true` a YAML number or boolean value for that field is accepted and converted to its string form — the number `42` becomes the string `"42"` and the boolean `true` becomes the string `"true"`. With `coerce` omitted or false the field stays strict and a non-string value is the usual type error; a value that is neither a string nor, under `coerce`, a number or boolean is always a type error.
